collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 2014 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 2014 to 2015 (W212) requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Psh Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this E Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
